propositions: Three diagnostic artifacts measuring completion-verifier runaway behavior exist on branch impl-10ae-verifier-ctx but are not ancestors of origin/main, making ticket evidence unverifiable on main.

The three artifacts (transcript markdown findings doc, transcript driver script, matrix budget-anchoring script) should be landed on main as reusable, parameterized diagnostic tools matching established docs/experiments/ convention.

Completion-verifier still reproduces runaway tool-call loops on current main (triggering max_consecutive_repeat guard at 66+ requests), indicating the underlying loop remains unfixed despite the guard backstop.

The landing of diagnostic artifacts to main enables re-runnable measurement against future verifier step-floor changes and resolves the hazard of evidence cited by path being unverifiable against the delivery branch.
